responsibility: Contains the declarative match-and-simplify rule set that drives GCC’s generated GENERIC and GIMPLE pattern folders. Through predicates, operator lists, and simplify/match rules, it specifies stable algebraic, bitwise, vector, builtin, conversion, and comparison rewrites that genmatch turns into generic-match.cc and gimple-match.cc, making this file the source of many canonical folding and simplification transformations rather than hand-written code.
same_name_distinction: Use this file when the root question is whether a tree expression, cast, comparison, or algebraic form should be simplified by generated match-and-simplify rules. Use fold-const.* for the hand-written folding engine and helper APIs; use front-end files such as c-typeck.c or c-fold.c when the issue is specific to C front-end construction before generic folding.
